rule: Templates não são liberação. Tokens da API preservados. Nenhum template envia mídia; use production_plan.py template.

families.title: Composição compartilhada
families.purpose: Propor o master espacial antes de animar.
families.promptTemplate: Single cinematic still. Andre screen-left, looking camera-right, seated across the same pale oak table. Image 1 is the real identity reference; image 2 is the table with its ring and chipped corner; image 3 is environment context. Historical interlocutor: only blurred shoulder and sleeve in the right foreground; entire head beyond the frame. Medium shot, fixed proposed 50 mm lens, seated eye level. Grey pinstripe jacket, open white striped shirt. {geometry} No historical face, head, profile, ear or reflection in frame. No extra person, readable text, camera cut or orbit.

families.title: Variante mínima de keyframe
families.purpose: Derivar escuta/fala do mesmo master selecionado.
families.promptTemplate: Preserve the exact composition, identity, seat, oak table, marks, wardrobe and light of image 1. Change only {minimal_change}. Do not add a character or recompose. No historical face, head, profile, ear or reflection in frame. No extra person, readable text, camera cut or orbit.

families.title: Fala visível com voz-guia
families.purpose: Uma fala inglesa exata; D14 mantém voz como guia.
families.promptTemplate: Locked camera. Andre speaks the exact English line once: "{canonical_dialogue}". Calm, warm delivery, one small grounded gesture away from the face, then mouth closes and he listens. Keep the selected identity, wardrobe, table, seat and light. No extra words or voice-over. Native sound is guide only, not the approved final voice. No historical face, head, profile, ear or reflection in frame. No extra person, readable text, camera cut or orbit.

families.title: Escuta ou reação motivada
families.purpose: Uma reação após a ideia que a provoca; sem inventar silêncio de áudio.
families.promptTemplate: Locked framing from the input. {reaction_after_cause}. One restrained change, natural stillness, no repeated blinking, no speech. Maintain the selected crop throughout. No pullback, cut or new face. Eyes-only crop must never reveal the rest of the face.
requiredDecisions: Recorte seguro em todos os quadros

families.title: Contato e detalhe
families.purpose: Mãos, mesa ou pés; não pressupõe Element facial.
families.promptTemplate: Locked detail. {one_contact_action}. Keep anatomy, cloth, table grain, ring stain, chipped corner and light unchanged. No head, face, reflected face or pullback. No speech.

families.title: Atuação por motion control
families.purpose: Imagem define aparência; referência qualificada fornece movimento.
families.promptTemplate: Transfer only the selected performance to the subject image. Preserve identity, costume, framing and environment. {performance_intention}. No historical face, head, profile, ear or reflection in frame. No extra person, readable text, camera cut or orbit.
requiredDecisions: Direção da imagem ou do vídeo

families.title: Primeiro e último quadro
families.purpose: Transição limitada entre dois keyframes compatíveis.
families.promptTemplate: Locked camera. Begin exactly in the first frame and make only {minimal_transition}, ending at the tail frame. Preserve character, table, seat and light. No historical face, head, profile, ear or reflection in frame. No extra person, readable text, camera cut or orbit.
requiredDecisions: Sem confundir referências Omni com cauda nomeada
